debit.notes: Block via Online Banking or SC Mobile: log in, select Help & Services > Card Management > Report Lost/Stolen Card; the card is blocked and a replacement sent to the registered mailing address. Overseas (International Banking helpline): Bahrain 80000448, UAE 8000177750, Hong Kong 800905108, Singapore 8001012407, Malaysia 1800815063, UK 8081019144, Philippines 180011101121, USA (New York) 8773021657, Canada 8772185618, Nigeria 7080601549. customer.care@sc.com is the published customer-care email for all other accounts. No SMS block keyword is published on the bank's pages.
